items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMyNTQ1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bc0cf024a4b203d32978d106c4b45616de6a34a5/GCO26_Banner.png) ​ Gapan Christmas Open 2026 is a World Cube Association (WCA)-sanctioned speedcubing competition to be held at Gapan City, Nueva Ecija, this December. The competition welcomes speedcubers of different ages and skill levels to participate in official WCA events, challenge themselves, and enjoy a day of sportsmanship and community. We look forward to welcoming everyone for an exciting celebration of speedcubing this Christmas season! Hosted by the [Central Luzon Cubers](https://www.facebook.com/centralluzoncubers) in partnership with [Robinsons Place Gapan](https://www.facebook.com/robinsonsgapan).

items.information: # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjMyNjQ2LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--5612c7641aa04a36ff0d0f0adc12b78a898595c8/imagen.png) # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaGxIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e1a87d9563999f890af638f98836b63b2aac90c5/6u.png) Español Límite de competidores: 40 * Leer el [Reglamento de la WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) para evitar posibles inconvenientes. * Esta competencia está abierta a competidores de cualquier nacionalidad, cualquier edad y a nuevos competidores, sin importar sus tiempos de resolución. * **COMPETIDORES NUEVOS**: deben leer [Importante](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2026#81756-importante-read) y [Competidores nuevos](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2026#81757-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Los competidores deben llevar sus propios puzzles. * Los competidores deben estar presentes y listos para competir cuando se los llama. * Es importante leer toda la información disponible en la página de la competencia. Ante cualquier duda, consultar a los organizadores o los delegados de la WCA. # ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsibWVzc2FnZSI6IkJBaHBBaHBIIiwiZXhwIjpudWxsLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bacb00caed7d0c9177dc3ea7d687667b270ce30d/6i.png) English Competitor limit: 40 * Read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) to avoid any issue. * This competition is open to competitors of any nationality or age. * **NEW COMPETITORS**: You must read [Important](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2026#81756-importante-read) and [New competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/MontevideoenLlamas2026#81757-competidores-nuevos-newcomers). * Competitors must bring their own puzzles. * Competitors must be present and ready to compete when called. * It is important to read all the information available on the competition's website. Feel free to contact the organizers or the WCA Delegates.
